title: AI Assistant
readerIntent: Understand conversational help, retrieval, tools, streaming, confirmations, and recovery.
priorKnowledge: Understand providers, knowledge, APIs, and employee security.
owner: aiAssistant orchestration; Knowledge, Provider, Workflow, and target modules retain their authorities
summary: Assistant persists conversations, messages, turns, safe events, citations, usage, leases, cancellation, and confirmation state while delegating generation, retrieval, and business work to owned contracts.

sections.heading: Turn lifecycle
items: Authenticate a tenant-scoped human employee and enforce conversation ownership.
Accept an idempotent turn and return 202 while background orchestration obtains a durable lease.
Build bounded redacted context and retrieve citation evidence through AI Knowledge.
Call aiProviders for normalized answer or policy-allowed tool planning.
Resolve current tool contracts through BackOffice observation and invoke target APIs through DefaultModuleService.
Persist safe lifecycle events and usage; never persist raw tool business results or secret arguments.
Stream replay/live normalized events over authenticated SSE with cursor, heartbeat, buffering, disconnect cleanup, and cancellation.

sections.heading: SSE versus WebSocket
paragraphs: SSE is the version 1 transport because turns primarily stream server events after HTTP commands and reconnect using persisted cursors. WebSocket is reserved for future genuinely bidirectional low-latency collaboration, not required for ordinary assistant turns.

sections.heading: Conversation example
items: An employee writes, "Create an enterprise." Assistant resolves an approved enterprise-creation tool and asks only for missing required information such as tenant, code, name, and policy-controlled relationships.
It may search selectable tenants through Profile's authorized API, but it cannot fabricate a tenant, accept an unauthorized identifier, or call a database directly.
Before mutation, Axis displays a structured summary of immutable arguments and consequences. The employee confirms that exact digest; changed arguments require a new confirmation.

The target module performs final authorization and validation. Assistant streams progress and the safe result, while workflow takes ownership if the operation requires approval or multiple durable steps.

sections.heading: Recovery and security
items: Distributed leases and heartbeats prevent duplicate owners.
Cancellation intent is durable and observed by the owner.
Abandoned uncertain provider calls reconcile without blind replay.
Assistant requires employee identity and denies configured non-employee groups.
Target route performs final authorization, validation, query projection, and mutation.

sections.heading: Frontend and operational contract
items: Axis renders conversations, status, progress labels, citations, tool proposals, confirmations, errors, cancellation, and reconnect state. It contains no business execution logic or provider credentials.
Backend content definitions supply user-facing labels and help text so localization and terminology can evolve without duplicating authority in the client.

SSE events use stable types, sequence/cursor identity, tenant-safe payloads, and replay boundaries. Browser refresh resumes an authenticated session without storing bearer tokens in unsafe persistent browser storage.

Acceptance covers duplicate turns, reconnect, cursor expiry, cancellation race, lease takeover, malformed tool arguments, target denial, provider timeout, uncertain outcome, workflow handoff, redaction, retention, accessibility, and responsive rendering.
